name: Diff view
description: 按会话和用户轮次保存修改证据、文末卡片与输入框浮窗，另设独立本地 Git 管理。
author: new-Beginner
safetyNotes: 可信本地插件：Agent/renderer 扩展无 OS 沙箱。捕获明确文件工具目标及有界 Shell/Task 工作区端点快照，排除凭据、私有数据和链接；并发归属不明标记不确定，不伪造统计。只读当前授权会话 JSONL 与原生修改证据用于历史恢复，不修改宿主记录、不读凭据、不联网。去正文的结构化工具证据持久化在插件数据区，单会话 8 MiB、最多 200 份、总量 128 MiB；清理历史时删除。恢复数据和持久导航令牌存插件数据区。公开插槽绘制浮窗，内部宿主 store 读取当前会话身份/运行元数据和打开页签；原生 UI 验收尚待完成。Git 独立入口，仅人工本地操作，提交/分支切换/删除/stash 等需确认，不提供远程操作。Git hooks/filters 为受信任本地代码。

en.description: Session-isolated history, reply cards, running changes and independent local Git management.
en.safetyNotes: Trusted unsandboxed local plugin. Captures explicit file targets and bounded Shell/Task workspace endpoints; uncertain attribution stays explicit. Reads authorized session transcripts and native change evidence locally for recovery, never credentials or host database writes. Sanitized structured tool evidence persists in plugin data: 8 MiB per session/root record, 200 records, 128 MiB total; deleted with plugin history. No chat prose, network or remote Git. Persistent session-scoped navigation. Local Git mutations require explicit UI actions and confirmations; repository hooks/filters are trusted code. Native UI acceptance is not yet completed.
